g.text: UCOPE 8601: one continuous matched training pair
Three checkpoints fixed before the run; 64 shared evaluation worlds per panel. Error bars condition on the fitted policies.
One matched training instance: checkpoints are not independent seeds; training-population uncertainty is not estimated.
